let keeper = SqliteConnection::connect_with(&options).await?; let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new() .min_connections(1) .idle_timeout(None) .connect_with(options) .await?; sqlx::raw_sql(SCHEMA).execute(&pool).await?; Ok((pool, keeper)) } /// The scenario, on whichever database the app runs. async fn a_small_image_is_made_at_once(broker: BrokerHandle<'_>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let image = Image { path: "cat.png".to_owned(), large: false, }; broker.message(&image).publish().await?; broker .subscriber("thumbnails") .assert_called_once() .with(&image) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); Ok(()) } #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn in_process() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let (pool, _keeper) = database("guide_testing").await?; let tb = TestApp::start(service(pool.clone())).await?; a_small_image_is_made_at_once(tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>()).await?; let left: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM thumbnail_jobs") .fetch_one(&pool) .await?; assert_eq!(left, 0, "the acknowledgement deleted the row"); Ok(()) } src/main.rs /// A database in memory that every connection naming it shares, alive while one of them is /// open: the test holds that one beside the pool. async fn database(name: &str) -> Result<(SqlitePool, SqliteConnection), Box<dyn Error>> { let options: SqliteConnectOptions = format!("sqlite:file:{name}?mode=memory&cache=shared").parse()?; let keeper = SqliteConnection::connect_with(&options).await?; let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new() .min_connections(1) .idle_timeout(None) .connect_with(options) .await?; sqlx::raw_sql(SCHEMA).execute(&pool).await?; Ok((pool, keeper)) } /// The scenario, on whichever database the app runs. async fn a_small_image_is_made_at_once(broker: BrokerHandle<'_>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let image = Image { path: "cat.png".to_owned(), large: false, }; broker.message(&image).publish().await?; broker .subscriber("thumbnails") .assert_called_once() .with(&image) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); Ok(()) } #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn in_process() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let (pool, _keeper) = database("manual_guide_testing").await?; let tb = TestApp::start(service(pool.clone())).await?; a_small_image_is_made_at_once(tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>()).await?; let left: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM thumbnail_jobs") .fetch_one(&pool) .await?; assert_eq!(left, 0, "the acknowledgement deleted the row"); Ok(()) } database 在内存中创建一个 SQLite 数据库，所有指名它的连接共享这个数据库。只要其中一个连接仍然打开，它就存在，所以测试在连接池之外再持有一个连接，并像服务的迁移那样创建表。TestApp::start 在进程内把生产环境的应用连接到这个数据库，测试按生产类型访问 Broker：tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>()。 图片像在生产环境中一样，经由路由和服务自己的 Publish 进入队列。publish 在它唤醒的处理器完成结算后才返回，所以它之后的几行读到的是已经完成的状态：thumbnail 如何结算该行，以及测试自己的查询在表中找到什么。测试用自己的 SQL 写入的行，只有在领取取走它时才被计入，所以 settle 不等待它；这样的测试在真实时钟上运行，并让轮询间隔过去，任务入队一页就是这样做的。场景把 Broker 的句柄作为参数接收，所以下面的 Postgres 测试也运行它。 没有载荷列的表把行本身交给它的处理器（行）。测试这样的处理器时，用 with_value 和 received_values 检查行，代替 with 和 received。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_large_image_is_made_a_minute_later() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let (pool, _keeper) = database("guide_testing_clock").await?; // The queue reads "now" from this clock, and the database calls run off it. A paused // clock takes the single-threaded runtime `#[tokio::test]` starts. tokio::time::pause(); let tb = TestApp::start(service(pool)).await?; tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>() .message(&Image { path: "panorama.png".to_owned(), large: true, }) .publish() .await?; tb.advance(Duration::from_secs(61)).await?; // Put off for a minute, then made. let outcomes = tb .broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>() .subscriber("thumbnails") .assert_called(2) .outcomes(); assert_eq!(outcomes, [Outcome::Nack, Outcome::Ack]); Ok(()) } src/main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_large_image_is_made_a_minute_later() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let (pool, _keeper) = database("manual_guide_testing_clock").await?; // The queue reads "now" from this clock, and the database calls run off it. A paused // clock takes the single-threaded runtime `#[tokio::test]` starts. tokio::time::pause(); let tb = TestApp::start(service(pool)).await?; tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>() .message(&Image { path: "panorama.png".to_owned(), large: true, }) .publish() .await?; tb.advance(Duration::from_secs(61)).await?; // Put off for a minute, then made. let outcomes = tb .broker::<SqlxBroker<Sqlite>>() .subscriber("thumbnails") .assert_called(2) .outcomes(); assert_eq!(outcomes, [Outcome::Nack, Outcome::Ack]); Ok(()) } 在进程内，队列从 tokio 时钟读取“现在”，并在 Broker 连接时以系统时钟为基准。测试暂停这个时钟，再用 advance 推动它：大图片的行在一分钟后到期，第二次投递生成缩略图。这一分钟不花任何时间。数据库调用脱离暂停的时钟运行，所以数据库应答期间时钟不会跳动。时钟越过租约时，租约也以同样的方式到期。使用数据库时钟的表读取数据库的时间，测试时钟推动不了它，服务自己的时钟也照常生效；这些情形的测试在真实时钟上运行。

宏 手写 src/main.rs // Skips without `POSTGRES_TEST_URL`; fails the skip under `RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE`. #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn on_postgres() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { // A database of the test's own on the server, dropped at the end. let Some(db) = live::postgres::database().await else { return Ok(()); }; sqlx::raw_sql(POSTGRES_SCHEMA).execute(&db.pool).await?; let tb = TestApp::start_live(service_on_postgres(db.pool.clone())).await?; a_small_image_is_made_at_once(tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Postgres>>()).await?; tb.shutdown().await?; db.finish().await; Ok(()) } src/main.rs // Skips without `POSTGRES_TEST_URL`; fails the skip under `RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE`. #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn on_postgres() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { // A database of the test's own on the server, dropped at the end. let Some(db) = live::postgres::database().await else { return Ok(()); }; sqlx::raw_sql(POSTGRES_SCHEMA).execute(&db.pool).await?; let tb = TestApp::start_live(service_on_postgres(db.pool.clone())).await?; a_small_image_is_made_at_once(tb.broker::<SqlxBroker<Postgres>>()).await?; tb.shutdown().await?; db.finish().await; Ok(()) } 在生产环境中运行于 Postgres 的服务，也要在 Postgres 上测试：SQLite 执行的是另一套 SQL，没有行锁、没有通知，也没有可选的隔离级别。TestApp::start_live 以普通方式连接应用，并在真实时钟上等待。测试在服务器上取得一个专用的数据库，并在其中创建表，因此不会读到先前运行留下的任何东西；live::postgres::database 是本仓库测试中的辅助函数，#[sqlx::test] 为测试提供同样的东西，即一个已应用迁移的数据库。测试从 POSTGRES_TEST_URL 读取服务器地址，没有这个变量时跳过，所以在没有服务器的机器上 cargo test 也能通过；在必须有服务器的地方，RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE=1 把这种跳过变成失败。场景就是进程内的那一个，原样不变。 cargo test POSTGRES_TEST_URL=postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/postgres cargo test

documents.t: 测试构建默认关闭 outbox，除非 RUSTSTREAM_SQLX_OUTBOX=on 启用它，所以服务自己的测试在不跟踪的情况下运行处理器。测试跟踪本身的测试在设置了开关时运行，没有开关时跳过（开关）。
本指南把处理器的写入与任务的结算一起提交，因此效果是同一数据库中的行的任务，恰好生效一次。 队列把每个任务至少投递一次。处理器写入结果后、任务结算前崩溃，就会再次运行，把结果写两遍。当结果是保存队列的那个数据库中的行时，一个事务就能消除这种重复：写入和结算要么一起提交，要么都不提交。 示例是一个退款服务。一次退款写入它的记录和一个交给发信服务的收据任务，并调用银行卡处理商。
documents.s: 数据库内的精确一次：事务处理器

documents.t: src/main.rs const SCHEMA: &str = " CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS refunds (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS refund_jobs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, locked_until TEXT, payload BLOB NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipt_jobs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, locked_until TEXT, payload BLOB NOT NULL ); "; 宏 手写 src/main.rs use ruststream_sqlx::prelude::*; use sqlx::{Sqlite, SqliteConnection, SqlitePool}; /// One row of `refund_jobs`, the refunds the shop's support queues. #[derive(Inbox, sqlx::FromRow)] #[inbox(table = "refund_jobs")] struct IssueRefund { #[field(id, generated)] id: i64, #[field(attempt, generated)] attempt: i16, #[field(locked_until)] locked_until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>, #[field(payload)] payload: Vec<u8>, } /// One row of `receipt_jobs`, the mailer's queue. #[derive(Inbox, sqlx::FromRow)] #[inbox(table = "receipt_jobs")] struct SendReceipt { #[field(id, generated)] id: i64, #[field(locked_until)] locked_until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>, #[field(payload)] payload: Vec<u8>, } src/main.rs use ruststream_sqlx::prelude::*; use sqlx::{Sqlite, SqliteConnection, SqlitePool}; /// One row of `refund_jobs`, the refunds the shop's support queues. #[derive(sqlx::FromRow)] struct IssueRefund { id: i64, attempt: i16, payload: Vec<u8>, } impl InboxTable for IssueRefund { type Id = i64; type Table = InboxSpec<(Attempt, Lease<DateTime<Utc>>, Payload)>; const TABLE: Self::Table = InboxSpec::new("refund_jobs", Column::new("id").generated()) .attempt(Column::new("attempt").generated()) .lease(Column::new("locked_until")) .payload(Column::new("payload")); fn id(&self) -> &i64 { &self.id } } impl AttemptRow for IssueRefund { type Attempt = i16; fn attempt(&self) -> &i16 { &self.attempt } } impl PayloadRow for IssueRefund { type Column = Vec<u8>; fn payload(&self) -> &[u8] { &self.payload } } refund_jobs 是本服务读取的队列。receipt_jobs 是发信服务的队列：本服务只向其中写入，用派生宏生成的 insert；在手写形式中，用它自己的一条语句。

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// The refund's record and its receipt, written on the connection of the delivery's transaction. async fn record( conn: &mut SqliteConnection, refund: &Refund, ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error + Send + Sync>> { sqlx::query("INSERT INTO refunds (order_id, amount_cents) VALUES (?, ?)") .bind(refund.order) .bind(refund.amount_cents) .execute(&mut *conn) .await?; let receipt = SendReceipt { id: 0, locked_until: None, payload: serde_json::to_vec(&Receipt { order: refund.order, })?, }; receipt.insert(conn).await?; Ok(()) } #[subscriber(InboxQueue::<IssueRefund>::new("refunds"))] async fn issue( refund: &Refund, Ctx(mut tx): Ctx<keys::Tx<Sqlite>>, Ctx(attempt): Ctx<keys::Attempt>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { if let Err(error) = record(&mut tx, refund).await { tracing::warn!(subscription = "refunds", refund.order, %error, "refund not recorded"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } // The processor takes the order as its idempotency key: a call repeated after a retry // refunds the card once. if !card_refund(refund, attempt).await { // The retry rolls the record and the receipt back first. return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } // The commit keeps the record and the receipt, and finishes the refund's row. HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn service(pool: SqlitePool) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("refunds", "0.1.0")).with_broker( SqlxBroker::new(pool).route::<IssueRefund>("refunds"), |b| { b.include(issue.transactional()); }, ) } src/main.rs /// The refund's record and its receipt, written on the connection of the delivery's transaction. async fn record( conn: &mut SqliteConnection, refund: &Refund, ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error + Send + Sync>> { sqlx::query("INSERT INTO refunds (order_id, amount_cents) VALUES (?, ?)") .bind(refund.order) .bind(refund.amount_cents) .execute(&mut *conn) .await?; // The mailer's queue, `receipt_jobs`. sqlx::query("INSERT INTO receipt_jobs (payload) VALUES (?)") .bind(serde_json::to_vec(&Receipt { order: refund.order, })?) .execute(conn) .await?; Ok(()) } struct Issue; impl Handle<Refund, (), (), TxContext<Sqlite>> for Issue { async fn handle( &self, refund: &Refund, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, TxContext<Sqlite>>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let Ctx(mut tx) = Ctx::<keys::Tx<Sqlite>>::from_context(ctx).await?; let Ctx(attempt) = Ctx::<keys::Attempt>::from_context(ctx).await?; if let Err(error) = record(&mut tx, refund).await { tracing::warn!(subscription = "refunds", refund.order, %error, "refund not recorded"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } // The processor takes the order as its idempotency key: a call repeated after a retry // refunds the card once. if !card_refund(refund, attempt).await { // The retry rolls the record and the receipt back first. return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } // The commit keeps the record and the receipt, and finishes the refund's row. Ok(()) } } fn service(pool: SqlitePool) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("refunds", "0.1.0")).with_broker( SqlxBroker::new(pool).route::<IssueRefund>("refunds"), |b| { let issue = subscriber("refunds", Issue) .map_source(|_| InboxQueue::<IssueRefund>::new("refunds")) .transactional(); b.include(issue.build()); }, ) } 挂载处的 .transactional() 把投递的事务借给处理器。处理器以第一个 Ctx 参数 Ctx<keys::Tx<Sqlite>> 接收它，并通过 &mut *tx 写入。在没有这个步骤的订阅上接收 keys::Tx 的处理器无法编译。 确认在一个事务中提交退款记录、收据任务和退款行的结算。其他任何结果都先回滚这些写入，再结算该行；重试仍然计入这次尝试。panic 什么也不提交。同一订单的第二次退款在 refunds 的主键上失败并被丢弃，因此进入队列的重复任务不会改变任何东西。 收据任务构成一条链：只有退款提交之后，发信服务才能看到它，回滚的退款则永远不会产生收据。通过 Ctx<keys::Pool> 的写入单独提交，与结果无关，经 Broker 的发布也是如此；两者都不加入这个事务。

银行卡处理商在数据库之外，因此没有事务能覆盖它。处理商已经退款之后的重试会再次调用它，所以调用带上幂等键，这里是订单，处理商只退款一次。数据库之外的每种效果都以同样的方式保持至少一次：一封邮件、一次 HTTP 调用、一次向另一个 Broker 的发布。把事件中继到另一个 Broker 和 outbox 两页处理发布。 在 SQLite 上，投递的事务在第一次写入时获取数据库的写锁，一直持有到投递结算，在此期间其他所有写入者都无法进入，领取也包括在内。这里处理商的调用在两次插入之后运行，所以调用期间数据库对其他写入者保持锁定。服务器只锁住事务写入的行。在 SQLite 上，发布 outbox 所跟踪消息的处理器，要在通过 tx 第一次写入之前发布：记录在自己的连接上写入，否则它要等待投递的写锁。

每个投递的事务按表的隔离级别打开，在服务器上是 #[inbox(isolation = read_committed)]；在 SQLite 上则按它的模式打开，即 #[inbox(mode = immediate)]。两者都未声明的表采用数据库的默认级别，在 MySQL 和 MariaDB 上是 READ COMMITTED。每个处理中的投递都为它的事务占用一个连接，所以通过 keys::Pool 或一次发布再取一个连接的处理器，需要比它的 workers(n) 更大的连接池。事务模式服务于逐条投递；以这种模式挂载的批处理器无法编译。在 MySQL 和 MariaDB 上，处理器若中途截断一条通过 tx 执行的语句，例如用 select! 包住一次查询，可能扰乱随后的结算，这是 sqlx-mysql 0.9.0 的一个缺陷：让每条语句执行完。
示例文件中的测试用 TestApp::start 在内存中的 SQLite 上运行服务，每次发布后读取这些表。一次退款提交一条记录和一张收据。第一次调用处理商超时的退款会重试，第二次尝试留下一条记录和一张收据，而不是两条。同一笔退款发布两次，第二次被丢弃。
